family: Caprifoliaceae (modern taxonomy; older Korean sources may use Valerianaceae)
source_taxon_scope: Valerianella locusta / Valerianella spp. esp. V. locusta
source_notes: The Tortoise Table lists Lamb's Lettuce / Corn Salad as Safe to Feed.
Its edible-plant guide describes leaves, flowers and stems as edible and calls Corn Salad a good addition to tortoise enclosure and diet.
Korean official sources independently anchor Valerianella locusta: APQA export-quarantine material uses 돌상추, Korea National Arboretum material uses 상치아재비, and Gangwon agricultural material uses 콘샐러드.
This is general tortoise guidance, not direct Mediterranean Testudo or Testudo graeca ibera feeding evidence.
limits: Do not infer a captive feeding percentage or staple ratio from Safe to Feed wording.
Do not upgrade general tortoise guidance to Mediterranean Testudo direct evidence.
램스레터스 is retained only as a market/transliterated alias; exact Korean identity is anchored primarily by official names 콘샐러드, 돌상추 and 상치아재비.
Family naming differs between modern taxonomy and older Valerianaceae usage; this does not change the candidate taxon.
